about: The ABSORB registry (grow/NEO.md, Order 7): open, machine-readable files on raw.githubusercontent.com, each under the licence its repository names. grow/absorb.mjs pulls them as a ring and turns them into teacher-format tasks with no model call. A file is data: never run. checked is the one GET that proved the row from this machine.
